~~~~~ IMPORTANT ~~~~~

PEACOCK WAS NOT MADE FOR PIRACY!!!

The ONLY reason this version of peacock works with pirated games is because it is MODIFIED AND NOT THE OFFICIAL VERSION!

Do NOT go to the peacock team for help with a pirated game/cracked peacock, they will know and you will just look stupid for failing to read.

~~~~~ INSTRUCTIONS ~~~~~

For pirated game + crack:

1. Run "PeacockPatcher.exe".
2. Run "Start Server.cmd" to start the server. This will open a command prompt.
3. Launch the cracked game. PeacockPatcher should detect the game's process ID and patch it, redirecting it to the selected server (usually "Peacock Local"/"127.0.0.1"/"localhost").

Once you enter the game and pass the main screen, everything is routed through the cracked Peacock server, giving you access to all DLCs and allowing you to play as if connected to official servers.

~~~~~ UPDATES & MORE ~~~~~

MAKE SURE TO BACKUP YOUR 'userdata' FOLDER FROM THE PEACOCK FOLDER BEFORE YOU UPDATE IT, THIS IS YOUR PROGRESS!

~~~~~ NOTES ~~~~~

Cracked Peacock doesn't need to connect to anything to verify/authenticate.
Really the only reason you may want to allow the server access to the internet is if you don't have the image pack, so that it can download missing images for you.

If the server was shut down improperly and now it won't launch, check your 'lop.json' file in the 'userdata/users' folder for corruption. 
If it's corrupted (random 0's etc), you can delete it and you shouldn't lose any progress.
If you still have issues then you should check your actual profile json for corruption.

As long as you close the Peacock server a little after the game then you shouldn't face any issues.
